subject.title: Feature request: denyFrom / groupDenyFrom — channel access control is allowlist-only

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class deny-list configuration for channel sender and group access control, and should that policy be WhatsApp-only or a shared channel contract?
rationale: The request adds a security-adjacent configuration capability whose intended scope and precedence cannot be safely inferred from the issue alone.

options.title: Define a shared policy contract
options.body: Specify consistent deny-before-allow semantics and introduce it through the common channel access-control boundary where compatible.

options.title: Keep allow-list-only policy
options.body: Retain the current model and document a supported operational alternative if one exists.

options.title: Approve WhatsApp-only behavior
options.body: Add narrowly scoped WhatsApp deny lists only if cross-channel consistency is intentionally not desired.

recommendation.title: Define a shared policy contract
recommendation.body: Specify consistent deny-before-allow semantics and introduce it through the common channel access-control boundary where compatible.
